name: Death Defier
summary: +1 Constitution, your Constitution modifier on Death Saving Throws, and once per Long Rest an outright kill or a drop to 0 without damage leaves you at HP equal to your level.

benefits.name: Cling to Life
benefits.summary: Add your Constitution modifier (minimum 1) to Death Saving Throws.
benefits.text: You add your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1) to your Death Saving Throws.

benefits.name: Enduring Vitality
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, an effect that would kill you outright without Death Saves, or drop you to 0 HP without dealing damage, leaves you at HP equal to your level instead.
benefits.text: If an effect would kill you outright without Death Saving Throws, or would reduce you directly to 0 Hit Points without dealing damage, you are instead reduced to a number of Hit Points equal to your level. You can't use this again until you finish a Long Rest.
